review.reason: The November Charges card-payment-creation deprecation and new-integration bar are accurately scoped and dated against the April captures. The candidate retains one materially misleading statement in its multi-raw Sources section: it generalizes a deprecated Sources API route into deprecation of the named payment methods themselves.
required_changes: In wiki/sources/source-stripe-legacy-apis.md under 'Sources API Concepts', replace 'All push payment methods (Alipay, Bancontact, giropay, iDEAL, Przelewy24, WeChat Pay, Sofort, Multibanco) are now deprecated.' The April Sources page says the Sources API's local-payment-method support is deprecated and being removed (raw/stripe-sources-api-2025.md lines 8-10), and its table labels those methods inside the Sources API route (lines 25-40). The current wording would make a query about whether iDEAL or Bancontact as payment methods are generally deprecated return a false answer. Scope the warning explicitly to accepting those methods through the deprecated Sources API, retain the April provenance, and avoid asserting the method itself is unavailable through current APIs. Keep the Charges correction and original Q1/Q2 answer boundaries intact.

source_decisions.reason: The retained Sources section labels payment methods themselves deprecated, although the cited April page limits the deprecation notice to their Sources API integration route.
